transport: MCP stdio server registered as id: mcp-vision in the DSH profile patch (must be wrapped in an insert)

tools.name: vision_read_document
tools.limits: text layer used when a page has >=120 chars; password-protected PDFs are refused with a clear message

tools.name: vision_ocr
tools.useFor: scans, photos of text, screenshots, labels, tables
tools.limits: no token limit; native resolution; upstream hardcodes CPU

tools.name: vision_describe
tools.limits: auto crop + downscale to <=980 visual tokens

tools.name: vision_ask
tools.useFor: visual QA, counting, spatial relations, chart reading
tools.limits: auto crop + downscale to <=980 visual tokens

tools.name: vision_status
tools.useFor: engine, device, budget, and per-model [present]/[MISSING] health check

tools.name: vision_detect
tools.useFor: locating and counting objects, defect localisation, base model for fine-tuning
tools.limits: COCO 80 classes; static 416x416 input; tiny model, so scores are modest on large photos
tools.params: conf=0.25, iou=0.45, classes="" (comma-separated names or ids), device=NPU, max_det=30, annotate_image=true

tools.name: anomaly_score
tools.useFor: unsupervised surface inspection: screen parts against a known-good baseline without labelled defects
tools.limits: trained on normal samples only; currently the synthetic demo model - retrain on the real product; input RGB [0,1] at 256x256; output is a model score, not a measurement
tools.params: device=NPU, save_heatmap=true (heatmap marks where the anomaly is)

tools.name: image_generate
tools.useFor: creating illustrations, textures and synthetic training data from a text prompt
tools.limits: FLUX.1-schnell is timestep-distilled: 4 steps, guidance_scale=0.0 must be passed explicitly (the library default of 7.5 would wreck the output); licence Apache-2.0; first call includes compilation (about 30-50 s); model 8.61 GB
tools.params: prompt, negative_prompt="", width=1024, height=1024, steps=4, guidance=0.0, seed=-1, device=GPU

tools.name: image_generate_uncensored
tools.backend: Qwen-Image 2.1 uncensored (Q4_K_M GGUF) via stable-diffusion.cpp, Vulkan backend
tools.useFor: 无内容审查的文生图；仅在用户明确要求无审查或换模型时使用

limits.license: Qwen Research License - research/evaluation only, NO commercial use
limits.reloadPerCall: engine has no daemon mode; each call re-reads 9.3 GB of weights (about 4 s warm, about 1 min cold)

tools.prefer: image_generate (14-18x faster, Apache-2.0) for anything publishable or commercial

routing:
born-digital PDF -> vision_read_document (text layer first; never OCR a text-layer PDF) scanned or photographed text, screenshots, labels -> vision_ocr figures, charts, diagrams, scenes, photos -> vision_describe or vision_ask numbers, part numbers, serial numbers, dimensions -> must come from the text layer or vision_ocr; never from the VLM large image with fine detail -> crop the region first tables -> vision_ocr locate or count objects -> vision_detect (returns boxes, labels, scores and an annotated image) numbers that come out of a detection (counts, positions) are model output, not OCR: state the confidence and the threshold used screen a part against a known-good baseline (no labelled defects) -> anomaly_score (returns a score, a normal/defect decision and a heatmap) anomaly scores are model output, not measurements: report them as such and never as a pass/fail certificate need a picture that does not exist -> image_generate (local FLUX.1-schnell int4, Apache-2.0, 1024x1024 in about 13-18 s warm) generated images are synthetic: never present them as photographs of a real object, and label them when they feed a dataset
10) need uncensored output -> image_generate_uncensored (85 s - 6 min; only when explicitly asked)

hardLimits.maxPromptLen: NPU-only option; accepting a larger value still yields empty output, so it is unusable
hardLimits.emptyOutput: model occasionally samples EOS first; server retries with a min_new_tokens ladder (1 -> 32 -> 96)
hardLimits.vlmHallucination: identifiers and numbers must be verified by OCR or the text layer
hardLimits.encryptedPdf: not supported: a PDF with a user password cannot be read; owner-password-only files that open with an empty password are fine. The tool returns 'READ FAILED [RuntimeError]: password-protected PDF ...'

trust.ppocr: high (matches the text layer verbatim in tests)
trust.vlm: medium-low: reliable on gist, unreliable on detail and categories
trust.yolox: medium: boxes are stable and device-independent, but class labels can be wrong (a capsule-toy machine was labelled suitcase)
trust.patchcore: medium-high on its own training distribution (demo set fully separable); it will not transfer to a different product without retraining
trust.imageGeneration: synthetic by construction: usable as illustration or augmentation data, never as evidence about the real world

vlmOnlyAnswerPolicy.noticeTemplate: ⚠️ 来源提示：以下内容由本地视觉模型（Qwen2.5-VL-3B @ NPU，耗时 {seconds}s）生成，未与文字层/OCR 交叉校验；其中数字、型号、标签文字等关键信息可能有误。需要精确值时，请让我用 vision_ocr 复核。
vlmOnlyAnswerPolicy.noPreciseValueContent: scene, layout, pose, colour and object-category descriptions may be stated directly, but the tool and elapsed time must still be named

imageGenerationBudget.reproducibility: fix seed when the user asks for the same image; do not re-roll seeds for taste
imageGenerationBudget.report: one line: count / size / steps / total time / file path
imageGenerationBudget.forbidden: dozens or hundreds of images per request, per-image review loops, unbounded retries
imageGenerationBudget.appliesToUncensored: same one-image default and 4-image ceiling, but each image takes 85 s - 6 min, so be stricter

hardwareLongevity.rationale: this is a laptop: thermals, fan wear and battery life are real constraints
rules: prefer NPU/iGPU over CPU (same work, far less heat)
use the cheapest adequate tool (text layer > OCR > VLM > detect/anomaly > generation/training)
pipelines are cached per device: do not warm up or restart the server needlessly (exception: a configuration change requires a restart, see maintenance)
announce any job above 60 s of sustained load, prefer AC power, never run heavy jobs concurrently
avoid pointless large writes; models are downloaded once and cached
monitor the ACPI thermal zone (idle baseline about 27.9 C on this machine); MSAcpi_ThermalZoneTemperature is access-denied here
keep long jobs interruptible and split them into batches

maintenance.rule: after changing any model path, restart the MCP server process and verify with vision_status
maintenance.why: the server is a long-lived process: it keeps the configuration it loaded at startup, so a deleted or replaced model directory makes tools fail silently (happened 2026-10-05)
maintenance.verify: call vision_status; every model line must read [present]
maintenance.diagnose: read the tail of D:\AI_file\logs\vision-mcp.log (v1.9 logs model checks at startup and failures at call time)
maintenance.never: do not delete or move a model directory while a server process may still reference it
maintenance.returnErrorsAsText: tools return failure messages as normal text (READ FAILED / GENERATION FAILED) because the MCP layer hides exception text from callers; every failure is also written to vision-mcp.log

privacy: all inference is local; no network calls; nothing leaves the machine
cost: no API cost; choose the cheapest adequate tool to save time, not money

reservedToolsNaming.convention: vision_* for perception, image_* for generation, anomaly_* for anomaly scoring

changeProcess: mirror to policy\deploy\global-agents.md when it affects every conversation
write a change log under logs\<conv-id>\
thinkingLanguage: zh-CN: reason, plan and draft in Chinese; keep code, commands, identifiers and paths verbatim
